top_choice_rationale: P001 honours two mechanistically transparent, widely replicated achievements within the three-laureate cap: base editing (a deaminase tethered to a nickase converting a defined base without a double-strand break, with an evolved DNA-acting adenine deaminase) credited to Liu, and PROTAC heterobifunctional degradation with a measurable ternary complex and a clean 2001 founding concept credited to Crews and Deshaies. Attribution is imperfect (Komor, Gaudelli, Sakamoto, Kim, Handa), so P002, the Liu, Komor and Gaudelli base-editing prize, is my fallback.
